high_confidence_errors.ai_root_cause: Port Fa0/5 is unassigned and defaulting to VLAN 1.
high_confidence_errors.human_root_cause: Port Fa0/5 is assigned to VLAN 1 (default) instead of VLAN 50 (Engineering).
high_confidence_errors.reason: AI correctly identified VLAN issue but human reviewer clarified exact missing target VLAN (VLAN 50).

high_confidence_errors.ai_root_cause: Default gateway IP is mistyped as 192.168.1.250 instead of 192.168.1.254.
high_confidence_errors.human_root_cause: Default gateway IP on PC1 is set to 192.168.1.250 which does not exist on R1 Gi0/0 (192.168.1.254).
high_confidence_errors.reason: AI attributed failure to routing table; reviewer corrected to host IP configuration typo.

high_confidence_errors.ai_root_cause: DHCP server service is turned off globally.
high_confidence_errors.human_root_cause: DHCP network statement subnet 192.168.2.0/24 mismatches interface Gi0/1 IP 192.168.10.1/24.
high_confidence_errors.reason: AI wrongly claimed service dhcp was disabled. Show run showed service enabled but wrong network statement.

high_confidence_errors.ai_root_cause: DNS server hostname resolution is disabled on local gateway router.
high_confidence_errors.human_root_cause: Router missing ip domain-lookup and ip name-server 8.8.8.8 configuration statements.
high_confidence_errors.reason: AI diagnosis was vague; reviewer specified exact missing Cisco IOS commands.

high_confidence_errors.ai_root_cause: Interface Gi0/0 is configured as passive-interface under RIP process.
high_confidence_errors.human_root_cause: RIP version mismatch: R1 is running RIPv1 while R2 sends RIPv2 updates.
high_confidence_errors.reason: AI claimed passive-interface issue, but show run shows no passive-interface line. Fault is RIP version mismatch.

high_confidence_errors.ai_root_cause: ACL 100 applied in out direction instead of in direction on Gi0/0.
high_confidence_errors.human_root_cause: ACL 100 applied inbound on wrong interface Gi0/1 instead of target LAN interface Gi0/0.
high_confidence_errors.reason: AI correctly identified directional error but missed interface assignment mismatch.

high_confidence_errors.ai_root_cause: Static NAT entry maps public IP to wrong internal IP address.
high_confidence_errors.human_root_cause: Static NAT translation rule has typo in inside local address (192.168.1.50 vs server IP 192.168.1.5).
high_confidence_errors.reason: AI diagnosed static NAT error; reviewer corrected exact internal server host IP.

high_confidence_errors.ai_root_cause: Guest client isolation ACL not applied on switch access port.
high_confidence_errors.human_root_cause: AP switch port Fa0/12 missing switchport trunk allowed vlan 50 for Guest WLAN traffic.
high_confidence_errors.reason: AI blamed guest isolation ACL; show interfaces trunk confirmed VLAN 50 was missing on AP trunk link.

lessons_learned_summary: Verify exact interface status and VLAN allowed lists before assuming Layer 3 routing failures.
Provide exact Cisco IOS syntax commands in remediation recommendations.
